captions.cayley: (a) The upper half-plane $\operatorname{Im} z>0$ with the point $i$. (b) Its image under $F(z)=(z-i)/(z+i)$, the unit disk, with $F(i)=0$. A checkerboard of unit cells in the $z$-plane is carried by $F$; the point at infinity goes to $1$ (open circle).
captions.wide: (a) The upper half-plane $\operatorname{Im} z>0$ with the point $i$. (b) Its image under $F(z)=(z-i)/(z+i)$, the unit disk, with $F(i)=0$; the point at infinity goes to $1$ (open circle). (c) Detail of (b) near $w=1$, where the image cells accumulate. Shading: a checkerboard of unit cells in the $z$-plane and its image.
captions.homework: $w=(z-i)/(z+i)$ on $\mathbb{H}$: the points $A$--$E$ and their images $A'$--$E'$. Dashed: boundary not included; arrowheads: orientation.
captions.film: The Cayley map as a deformation: $H_t(\mathbb{H})$ at (a) $t=0$, (b) $t=1/3$, (c) $t=2/3$ and (d) $t=1$, where $H_t$ is the elliptic M\"obius map fixing $p=\tfrac{1+\sqrt3}{2}(1-i)$ and $q=\tfrac{1-\sqrt3}{2}(1-i)$ with $H_t'(p)=e^{2\pi i t/3}$, so $H_0=\mathrm{id}$ and $H_1=F$. Solid: the paths $t\mapsto H_t(z)$ of $z=i$ (circle), $0$ (square) and $1$ (triangle) up to the frame's $t$; dotted: the rest of each path; dashed: the real axis; open circle: $H_t(\infty)$.
captions.phase: Phase portrait of $f(z)=(z^3-1)/(z^2+1)$ on $[-2,2]^2$: the color shows $\arg f(z)$ (key at right) and the thin lines are the level sets $\arg f\in\frac{\pi}{6}\mathbb{Z}$. Zeros (dots) at the cube roots of unity; simple poles (open circles) at $\pm i$.
captions.phaseBW: Phase portrait of $f(z)=(z^3-1)/(z^2+1)$ on $[-2,2]^2$ as level sets of $\arg f$ at multiples of $\pi/6$; heavy: $\arg f=0$, dashed: $\arg f=\pi$. Bands: $\lfloor\log_2|f|\rfloor$ even (gray) or odd (white). Zeros (dots) at the cube roots of unity; simple poles (open circles) at $\pm i$.
